public_rationale: METR found substantial capability limits and judged several routes to catastrophic autonomy unlikely. That is relevant evidence against an immediate intelligence explosion. limitations: METR evaluated GPT-5 Thinking and selected threat models.
Its assessment relied partly on information supplied by OpenAI and underwent confidentiality review.
Scoring only what happened at launch would add an observation window Marcus did not state.
